note: Every register the tracer knows about. access: 'queried' = the browser queries it live; 'referral' = public, but no browser-usable API (key, User-Agent rule, SFTP, or web search only), so the tool hands the user a link; 'planned' = bulk data scheduled for the backend. 'covers' lists ISO2 jurisdictions or '*' for global. A register can only ever return a hit or no-evidence-found, never 'clear'.

registers.name: GLEIF LEI register
registers.holds: Legal name, previous legal names, trading names, status, parents
registers.caveat: Small employers rarely hold an LEI, so absence means nothing.

registers.name: New York Department of State corporations
registers.holds: Active NY entities, filing date, type
registers.caveat: Active entities only; assumed names (DBAs) are not in the open dataset.

registers.name: Colorado business entities
registers.holds: Status, formation date, registered agent
registers.caveat: Colorado-registered entities only.

registers.name: Colorado trade names (DBA)
registers.holds: Trade name to registrant entity
registers.caveat: Colorado filings only.

registers.name: UK Companies House
registers.holds: Previous company names, officers, PSCs, disqualified directors
registers.caveat: API needs a key held server-side; free and planned for the backend.

registers.name: SEC EDGAR
registers.holds: Former names with dates for SEC registrants
registers.caveat: Registrants only; name search needs a declared User-Agent, so server-side.

registers.name: Florida Sunbiz (incl. Fictitious Name file)
registers.holds: Corporate filings, DBAs, name-change events
registers.caveat: Bulk SFTP only.

registers.name: Texas Comptroller franchise tax and officers
registers.holds: Forfeited status, officers and directors
registers.caveat: Bulk files after portal registration.

registers.name: Receita Federal CNPJ (Brazil)
registers.holds: Legal name, nome fantasia, cadastral status, partners
registers.caveat: Lookup needs the CNPJ number.

registers.name: OpenCorporates
registers.holds: Companies and previous names across 140 jurisdictions
registers.caveat: No free API since 2025; the CoLab can apply under the academic route.

registers.name: Wikidata
registers.holds: Identifier crosswalk and official name history for large organisations
registers.caveat: Community data; certifies nothing, and absence means nothing for small firms.

registers.name: Job Risk Tracer case catalog
registers.holds: Sourced cases, entities, former names and aliases
registers.caveat: Hand-researched; a small set of documented cases, not a register.

registers.name: OpenSanctions (OFAC, UN, EU, UK, World Bank, SAM, Interpol, FBI, SEC, CFTC)
registers.holds: Sanctioned and debarred entities and principals, with aliases
registers.caveat: Bulk data is free for non-commercial use; self-hosted yente matching is planned.

registers.name: DOL OFLC recruiter list and debarments
registers.holds: H-2B foreign recruiters, H-2A/H-2B/PERM debarments
registers.caveat: Spreadsheets; planned for the backend.

registers.name: DOL Wage and Hour enforcement
registers.holds: Back wages, H-2A, MSPA and FLSA violations
registers.caveat: API key required.

registers.name: DOJ press releases
registers.holds: Indictments, pleas, settlements
registers.caveat: API does not allow browser requests; name matches need disambiguation.

registers.name: CourtListener federal dockets
registers.holds: Federal dockets naming the company
registers.caveat: Partial coverage; being named in a case is not a finding of wrongdoing.

registers.name: RDAP domain registration
registers.holds: Registration date, registrar
registers.caveat: ccTLD coverage is uneven.

registers.name: crt.sh certificate transparency
registers.holds: First certificate date
registers.caveat: No SLA; can time out.

registers.name: Wayback Machine
registers.holds: Whether the site has archive history
registers.caveat: Lack of captures is weak evidence.

registers.name: Tranco top sites
registers.holds: Popularity rank
registers.caveat: Most legitimate small employers are unranked.

registers.name: DNS: MX and DMARC
registers.holds: Whether the recruiter's email domain can receive mail and publishes DMARC
registers.caveat: Many small businesses lack DMARC.

registers.name: Free-mail and disposable-domain lists
registers.holds: Webmail and throwaway email domains
registers.caveat: Built-in subset; full lists planned.

registers.name: Spamhaus DBL / Cloudflare Radar
registers.holds: Domain blocklists and newly-seen-domain categories
registers.caveat: Free keys, server-side.

registers.name: ETC Forced Labor Structural Risk Index (FLSRI)
registers.holds: Country structural-risk composite, Recruitment and Exploitation phases, 11 domains, 90% rank bands, sub-national corridors
registers.caveat: Structural conditions, not prevalence, and never evidence about a company. Under-reads destination and sponsorship systems such as the Gulf.

registers.name: CTDC synthetic trafficking dataset
registers.holds: 206k case records: sector, recruitment method, means of control
registers.caveat: Priors for weighting, not evidence about any entity.

registers.name: ILO Indicators of Forced Labour (2025)
registers.holds: 11 indicators, mapped to the text signals
registers.caveat: Built into the offer-text rules.

registers.name: US TIP Report tiers
registers.holds: Country tier rankings
registers.caveat: A country prior, never a finding about a company.
